confidence_notes: Food estimates use a [June Numbeo snapshot](https://www.expatica.com/us/cost-of-living/denver-co/) and later [bar](https://tabtender.app/places/us/co/denver/bars) and [wine](https://tabtender.app/places/us/co/denver/prices/wine) menu aggregates. Lodging estimates are less certain, especially private hostel rooms and summer rates. Prices are estimated before tax and tips.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation estimates use general North American urban pricing, adjusted for Denver's summer tourism and convention demand.
